description: Implementation of the QpackDecoder class for handling QPACK decoding in QUIC protocol, including stream management, header table operations, and error handling.

classes.name: QpackDecoder
classes.description: Handles decoding of QPACK headers, manages header table, stream states, and error reporting.

methods.name: QpackDecoder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the decoder with capacity, stream limits, and error delegate.

methods.name: OnStreamReset
methods.description: Handles stream reset events, cancels stream if dynamic table capacity > 0.

methods.name: OnStreamBlocked
methods.description: Marks a stream as blocked and checks against maximum blocked streams.

methods.name: OnStreamUnblocked
methods.description: Removes a stream from blocked set.

methods.name: OnDecodingCompleted
methods.description: Handles completion of decoding for a stream, acknowledges headers, updates insert count.

methods.name: OnInsertWithNameReference
methods.description: Inserts header with name reference, handles static and dynamic entries, error checking.

methods.name: OnDuplicate
methods.description: Duplicates an existing header entry in the dynamic table.

methods.name: OnErrorDetected
methods.description: Handles error detection and delegates error reporting.

methods.name: CreateProgressiveDecoder
methods.description: Creates a new progressive decoder for a stream.
